'''Atmosphere exchangers''' were part of the [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]. They were located at the back of the vehicle, alongside the [[filtration unit]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
